candidate: A: verified completion/deferred final, react-v3, non-thinking
public_trace_findings: The completion guard worked mechanically: the only completed=true final first obtained public complete_task evidence.
That completed answer was wrong because the agent used an incomplete/unverified song search; successful completion evidence does not establish task correctness.
Five other episodes repeatedly requested broad API descriptions or invalid APIs until action/time exhaustion; non-thinking did not recover from the repetition.
The faster generation increased available turns but not useful progress, with a mean of 24 actions and no successes.
decision: Reject non-thinking candidate A and do not expand its population. Run the prespecified thinking candidate on the same screen and direct-objective/finalization revision. Preserve completion verification but treat it only as a correctness boundary, not a task-quality signal.
